resources.string: Shows the alarm that is ringing and opens it over the lock screen.
Tells you when an alarm did not ring or was not stopped.
The %1$s alarm did not ring. Open the reliability checks.
The %1$s alarm was cut off while it was ringing. Open the reliability checks.
The %1$s alarm rang for 30 minutes and then stopped.
The %1$s alarm came due while another alarm was ringing, so it did not ring by itself.
This alarm has no barcode, so this button stops it.
Point the camera at one of this alarm\'s barcodes.
%1$s is not one of this alarm\'s barcodes.
The camera permission is missing. Allow it, or type the code instead. If the phone is locked, unlock it first.
The camera did not open. Try again, or type the code instead. If the phone is locked, unlocking it can help.
The camera permission is off and the phone will not ask again. Type the code instead, or allow the camera in the app settings. If the phone is locked, it asks you to unlock first.
Type this code to stop the alarm. Pasting does not work.
Character %1$d is wrong. Delete it and try again.
